description: Tier-2 PSLQ extension: bridge ≥ 3 hyperbolic knots + higher-Heegaard-genus candidates (^6Li, ^7Li atlas, 9_42, 10_124, Whitehead) for BringHyperbolicDecomposition. Builds on Tier-0 + Tier-1 negative results.
tolerance_note: All basis values at ≥30 dps. ^6Li (K_11a259) and ^7Li (L_11a62) excluded because their atlas precision is only ~5 sig figs — including them generates spurious numerical 'relations' from rounding rather than structural integer relations. Whitehead = 4G = (1/2)·Borromean also excluded as known Q-degeneracy.
interpretation: NO non-trivial small relation at 100 dps with max coeff 10^6 and tol 1e-3. The 5 additional higher-bridge hyperbolic volumes do not bring 2/(3π) into the integer-multiple lattice. K-theoretic identification requires content outside the H_3 + bridge-3 hyperbolic regime — either genuinely higher Heegaard genus or a non-NF representative. The 'atlas alone' hypothesis is now ruled out at three tier levels.
